name: v1.6.6
body:
## 10/10/2026

### Changed

- Updated Node to 26.11.1, Claude Code to 2.1.296, Gemini CLI to 0.63.0, Codex to 0.162.1, Junie to stable 3579.5 and OpenCode to 1.18.35.
- Updated compatible developer and deployment tools using official upstream packages.
- EAS, Netlify and Vercel keep their official dependency trees.
- Updated Syft to 1.54.1, Grype to 0.120.1 and the artifact upload and download actions to 7.0.2 and 8.0.2.
- Kept CloudCLI account controls, notifications, proxy paths and existing plugins. See [deferred updates](https://github.com/CoderLuii/HolyClaude/blob/master/docs/official-dependency-updates.md) for compatibility details.

### Fixed

- Updated release validation to use v1.6.5 as the source parent while keeping retained artifact checks tied to their original reviewed baseline.
- Corrected the contributor guide's description of the Docker build stages.

### Security

- Dependency scans continue. Accepted upstream vulnerabilities remain unresolved; source, artifact integrity and runtime checks still block delivery.
